title: Checkride Prep Task Backlog
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=checkride:prep topic=* task_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(task_state!="done",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by topic
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending prep tasks backlog by checkride topic for checkride preparation.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside checkride preparation.
implementation: Mark each `checkride:prep` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `topic`.
visualization: Table of checkride topic with pending prep tasks counts.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates where unfinished prep tasks are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in checkride preparation.
